description: Self-hosted meeting minutes: record in the browser, transcribe and summarize on your own machine
notes: Voxinq is installed but not yet built. Finish with:
That installs the web dependencies, builds the app, and creates the transcription and
speaker-separation environments. It takes several minutes and needs the network, and on a
machine with an NVIDIA GPU it also fetches PyTorch, which is several gigabytes.
voxinq start          open it in a browser
voxinq autostart on   start it when you log in
PostgreSQL is bundled - there is nothing to install or configure for it. Your data lives in
%LOCALAPPDATA%\voxinq, outside this install, so upgrading cannot delete it.
Minutes need an LLM: `scoop install ollama`, or point Settings -> LLM at a cloud model.
With an NVIDIA GPU, speaker separation uses pyannote and needs a free Hugging Face token -
see docs/setup.md. Without one it uses ONNX models that need no account.
post_install: # The CLI's own dependencies -- the bundled PostgreSQL binaries among them. The app's are
# installed by `voxinq setup`, which the notes ask the user to run: it takes minutes and
# downloads models, which is not something to do silently inside a package install.
